turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40. Who decided on the zero, and why did my son find out about it on his phone in the middle of class?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked you who decided, and I'm still waiting.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
The day is young, and the principal's office is down the hall. You've had two chances to answer me. Who entered that zero?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
No deal. Nothing about my son stays between us, and I'm writing down that you asked. Who entered the zero, Hale?
